$comment: AI-EXECUTIVE application configuration. Paths are resolved at runtime; nothing here hardcodes a user or developer machine path.
$allowedCommandsNote: Empty means the command validator applies its deny-list only. Add program names (without extension) to widen the scope EXPLICITLY, e.g. ["git","node","npm","python","pip"]. Widening this list is a deliberate user decision and is logged in logs/security.log.

autonomy.$walkRealismNote: true = agents physically walk for the real backend-computed duration (no teleporting). false = short cinematic transits for low-power machines; agent logic is unchanged.

approvals.$approvalNote: Every approval carries the SHA-256 hash of the exact action. Parameters are re-hashed at execution time; any change invalidates the approval and asks again.
